design_inspiration: Explains an unfamiliar system through Grow, See and Harvest stages, then offers separate greenhouse-demo and business-case requests. The plants-to-robot contrast makes the technical approach easy to grasp. Numerical counters were unreliable in text extraction and excluded.

industry: Industrial automation / life sciences and semiconductors
design_inspiration: Separates life-science and semiconductor buyers, then divides each into individual products and integrated solutions. A download center and distinct robotics, vision, motion-control and optics sections support technical evaluation.

Organizes navigation three ways: product modules, buyer industries and specific tasks such as kitting or onboarding. Named customer stories and an accessible pricing path help visitors move from a broad platform to a relevant use case.

industry: Space / radar hardware and Earth data
design_inspiration: Breaks a radar platform into three clear commercial capabilities: turnkey sensors, multistatic systems and elevation datasets. Each has a short purpose statement and deeper link, keeping specialized technology navigable.

Pairs platform exploration with industry stories, then organizes named customer examples by outcomes such as performance, knowledge reuse and speed to decision. Each proof point links to a fuller case rather than leaving metrics isolated.

industry: Consumer health / scalp and hair care

Two solution-navigation systems let visitors browse by operational challenge or level of care. Technology, responsible AI/security and implementation each get a distinct explanation and destination, addressing buyer objections beyond model capability.

An eligibility CTA serves patients while referral and sales links serve organizations. Named patient stories lead into study-linked outcomes and a four-part explanation covering delivered equipment, a specialist appointment, group sessions and ongoing support.
